title: 第二十二章 羽仙子第二十三章 扶桑神树
lines: 两扇宏伟铜门上的浮雕图景，呈现两种截然不同的意境韵味。
左扇门上的“万家灯火”，就像在呈现一座真实的、充满人间烟火的古城。
只是注视片刻，李唯一就感觉灵魂仿佛被拉了进去。走在夜幕下的街道，周围是吆喝声，是车水马龙的市井之气。
右扇门上的“黄泉星河”，则是大气磅礴的气韵，繁密星辰汇聚成的河流。就像夜空中的银河系，不过这条星河不是银色，而是一片昏黄。
“这就是青铜船舰主人居住的地方？祂是否真的已经逝去？”
李唯一觉得，园林中能够散发出仙辉和水雾，里面或许存在泉水和神秘异宝。
船上，水可是十分紧缺。
金乌血和黑蛟血显然不能随便饮用，极其危险，不是解决问题的根本法。
“沙沙！”
刚走上石阶，便有一股风劲，不知从何处而来。
李唯一有超凡力量傍身，胆气十足，继续向上走。
来到石阶顶部。
他先是透过两扇门的缝隙，向里面窥望。
缝隙足有两指宽。
视野中，门后十分开阔，黑石堆砌而成的影壁下方，有一座黑白色彩的太极湖泊。
湖泊中心，插有一柄慑人心魄的巨剑，剑体是用森黑和猩红两种截然不同的材料铸成。
李唯一伸出双手，调动右足足心涌出的滚烫气流，想要尝试推门。
双手距离铜门还有半尺距离，一股排山倒海的力量，狂涌而来，将他震得犹如落叶般倒飞出去，轻飘飘落到石阶下方的地面。
“道祖太极鱼的新主人，这扇门，不是现在的你可以进。你是承受因果者，而非因果的缔造者。且去吧……”
一道若有若无的声音传来，似直接在李唯一脑海响起，又似从眼前的铜门中传出。
“你是什么人，你说的因果是什么？”李唯一问道。
没有任何回应。
空气震颤，一道半透明的光幕，沿院墙升起，将整个园林笼罩。
持续了很久才消散。
下逐客令了！
李唯一立即后退，盯向那道巨大的铜门，总觉得刚才的声音不像是存在于这个时空，更像是千年前的古人跟今人的对话。
很古怪的感觉。
毫无疑问，青铜船舰启航，包括他们坠微，与道祖太极鱼绝对脱不了干系。
师父啊，师父，你一定是知道一些什么。
成为阐门之主，到底要承受怎样可怕的因果？
“李唯一！”
蔡羽彤的声音，从身后传来。
李唯一长长吐出一口气，迅速收起脑海中的种种杂念，转过身……脸上刚浮现出来的笑容瞬间僵住，满目难以置信的上下打量蔡羽彤。
这是蔡学姐？
蔡羽彤穿着祁珊珊的白色医师服外套，外套也就垂至腰线下半尺，两条笔直而长得过分的玉腿几乎完全暴露在外。
更重要的是。
content_en:
;;
The relief scenes on the two magnificent bronze doors present two completely different artistic conceptions.
The "thousands of lights" on the left door seem to be showing a real ancient city full of human fireworks.
Just staring at it for a moment, Li Weiwei felt as if his soul was being pulled in. Walking down the street at night, you are surrounded by shouts and bustling traffic.
The "Yellow Spring Galaxy" on the right door is a majestic aura, a river formed by dense stars. It's like the Milky Way in the night sky, but this galaxy is not silver, but dim.
"Is this where the owner of the bronze ship lives? Has he really passed away?"
Li Weiwei felt that the garden could emit fairy light and mist, and there might be springs and mysterious treasures inside.
On the boat, water was in short supply.
Obviously, Golden Crow blood and Black Flood Dragon blood cannot be drunk casually. They are extremely dangerous and are not the fundamental solution to the problem.
"Shasha!"
As soon as I walked up the stone steps, I felt a strong wind coming from nowhere.
Li Weiwei had extraordinary strength and courage to continue walking upward.
Come to the top of the stone steps.
He first peeked inside through the gap between the two doors.
The gap is two fingers wide.
In the field of vision, there is a very open space behind the door. Under the screen wall made of black stones, there is a black and white Tai Chi lake.
In the center of the lake, there is a breathtaking giant sword. The sword body is made of two completely different materials: dark black and scarlet.
Li Weiwei stretched out his hands, mobilized the hot air flowing from the center of his right foot, and tried to push the door open.
"Boom!"
His hands were still half a foot away from the bronze door when an overwhelming force surged in, sending him flying backwards like a fallen leaf, falling lightly to the ground below the stone steps.
"The new owner of Daozu Taiji Fish, you cannot enter this door now. You are the recipient of cause and effect, not the creator of cause and effect. Go ahead..."
A faint voice came, as if it sounded directly in Li Weiwei's mind, and seemed to come from the bronze door in front of him.
"Who are you and what cause and effect are you talking about?" Li Weiwei asked.
No response.
"Wow!"
The air trembled, and a translucent light curtain rose along the courtyard wall, covering the entire garden.
It lasted for a long time before dissipating.
An eviction order has been issued!
Li Weiwei immediately stepped back and stared at the huge bronze door. He always felt that the voice just now did not seem to exist in this time and space, but more like a conversation between ancient people thousands of years ago and people today.
Very weird feeling.
There is no doubt that the setting off of the bronze ship, including their crash, is absolutely inseparable from Daozu Taijiyu.
Master, Master, you must know something.
What kind of terrible consequences will one have to bear to become the master of the Interpretation Sect?
"Li Weiwei!"
Cai Yutong's voice came from behind.
"Senior sister..."
Li Weiwei took a long breath, quickly put away all the distracting thoughts in his mind, and turned around... The smile that had just appeared on his face froze instantly, and he looked up and down at Cai Yutong in disbelief.
Is this Senior Sister Cai?
Cai Yutong was wearing Qi Shanshan's white doctor's uniform coat, which only hung down to half a foot below her waistline, and her two straight and excessively long legs were almost completely exposed.
What's more.
